This is a maraging steel, probably a C-type grade like Fe-17.5Ni-11.5Co-4.15Mo-1.48Ti-0.62Al. I'm estimating from memory and did not look up the dataset row. Maraging steels of this type, such as Vasco-type 350 grade, have yield strengths around 2400 MPa. Values in the matbench_steels dataset for similar compositions are about 2300–2500 MPa, so I'm picking a value in that range.
